title: CLAMBER: A Benchmark of Identifying and Clarifying Ambiguous Information Needs in Large Language Models
reasoning: The benchmark includes a specific component for evaluating religious and theological ambiguity. It uses examples such as 'saving from sins' versus 'saving money' to test ambiguity resolution and explicitly mentions using 'religious pronoun' as one of its three primary classification tasks for identifying ambiguity in its taxonomy (Section 3.1 and Appendix C.2).
